name: Banco da Amazônia S.A.
summary: Banco da Amazônia S.A. provides banking products and services in Brazil. The company offers checking, savings, simplified, and salary accounts; and credit cards. It also provides loan solutions; investment products, such as capitalization, bank deposit certificates and bank deposit receipts, agribusiness credit note, and Amazonia Prev Plus; car, home, travel, life and personal accident, personal lenders, aviation, fleet vehicle, and various machines and equipment insurance products.
